import argparse


def build_parser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="tool")
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    sync = sub.add_parser("sync", help="pull remote records")
    sync.add_argument("--since", help="only records changed after this ISO date")
    sync.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="pull every remote record")
    purge = sub.add_parser("purge", help="delete local records")
    purge.add_argument("--older-than", type=int, help="age in days")
    return parser

import statistics
import time

QUERIES = 500  # the declared sample size


def p95_ms(search, corpus, queries):
    samples = []
    for q in queries[:QUERIES]:
        start = time.perf_counter()
        search(corpus, q)
        samples.append((time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
    return statistics.quantiles(samples, n=100)[94]

oncall_fix.service/checkout.py:
import logging
import time
import uuid

from prometheus_client import Counter, Histogram

from service import mailer, payments

log = logging.getLogger("checkout")
CHECKOUTS = Counter("checkout_total", "Checkouts by outcome", ["outcome"])
LATENCY = Histogram("checkout_seconds", "Checkout latency")


def checkout(order_id, customer, card_number, amount, correlation_id=None):
    ctx = {"correlation_id": correlation_id or uuid.uuid4().hex, "order_id": order_id,
           "entry_point": "checkout"}
    started = time.monotonic()
    log.info("checkout.started", extra=ctx)
    try:
        payments.charge(card_number, amount)
        mailer.send_receipt(customer["email"], order_id)
    except Exception:
        CHECKOUTS.labels(outcome="error").inc()
        log.exception("checkout.failed", extra=ctx)
        raise
    finally:
        LATENCY.observe(time.monotonic() - started)
    CHECKOUTS.labels(outcome="paid").inc()
    log.info("checkout.paid", extra=ctx)
    return {"order_id": order_id, "status": "paid"}
